title: One conversation, start to idle

steps.label:
Summary of the oldest 20 written
in the background; no turn waits.

Oldest 20 become one summary message,
last 20 stay verbatim.
Same again, previous summary rolled in.

Remember tool saves a durable thing
the moment the athlete says it.

Sheet closes, app backgrounds, or a new
chat starts: client tells the server.

Server writes the episode once.
Next opener reads it, never waits.

example: Turn 45: one summary of messages 1 to 20, then 21 to 45.
Sheet closed 21:10: episode written before the 07:00 chat.
Removed: 3.5 s read-back wait, last-words fallback.
